description.narrative:
The Trade for Development Centre (TDC) works to make production and consumption chains sustainable and respectful of human rights  through 3 areas of intervention:
  • by supporting SME's and business support organisations in Africa through taillor made coaching in marketing, business management and human rights or through grants;
  • by participating in multi-stakeholder initiatives, f.e Beyond Chocolate;
  • And by awareness raising campaigns in Belgium and Africa for both consumers and political actors. 
Find out more on our website www.tdc-enabel.be.
